expected.reason: They pushed two commits to their own streamgate repo on 16 September: backpressure on a websocket fan-out, and dropping frames older than 200 ms. The work is close to GI's real-time streaming, but they have said nothing about it: there is no post and no release, and the reader's work-in-progress tag is a label on that same push, not a second sign. A push is everyday activity with nothing to write about beyond two commit messages, so keep watching for a post or release about it. Justin decided (2026-09-24): a push can back up a post or release but never makes the call by itself.
